Requirement: The app shall state its intended use, intended user profile and intended operational environment in its accompanying documentation.
The app shall provide correct results with the needed degree of precision and shall perform the functions it claims to perform.
The app shall provide guided cognitive behavioural therapy exercises.
The app shall provide a thought diary helping the user identify and challenge negative thinking patterns.
The app shall provide mindfulness or meditation sessions.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item CC2; Qu Table 1

Requirement: The app shall provide acceptance and commitment therapy tools.
The app shall provide relaxation techniques such as breathing or muscle relaxation exercises.
The app shall provide psychoeducational content about anxiety and depression.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri items CC5, EPC25; Qu Table 1

Requirement: The app shall provide behavioural techniques that guide the user to perform positive behaviours.
The app shall provide a means for the user to express their emotions.
The app shall allow the user to record and track their mood over time.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item SMR7; Qu Table 1, Tracking mood patterns; Wu Table 4

Requirement: The app shall allow the user to record triggers or context alongside mood entries.
The app shall support tracking of the user's thought patterns.
The app shall support ongoing monitoring of the user's depression symptoms during the intervention.
The app shall provide a screening function for self-assessment of depression using a validated instrument.
The app shall use its screening results as a basis for personalising the intervention.
The app shall prompt the user for regular emotional check-ins.
The app shall allow the user to set reminders for medication or self-care tasks.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item SMR9; Wu Table 4

Requirement: The app shall allow the user to view trends or summaries of their mental health data.
The app shall allow the user to track their progress through the intervention and receive feedback on it.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item EPC28; Qu Table 1

Requirement: The app shall provide goal-setting or value-reflection features.
The app shall adapt its content to the individual user based on their activity or stated needs.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item EPC26; Rickard item 13; Wu Table 4

Requirement: The app shall provide access to licensed professionals via chat or video.
The app shall provide guided therapy modules.
The app shall provide peer support forums or group chats.
The app shall provide community events or discussion groups.
The app shall allow the user to receive encouragement or feedback from peers or moderators.
The app shall support offline access to its key features.
The app shall allow the user to export or share their data with a third party such as a clinician.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item TF35; Rickard item 14

Requirement: The app shall identify the organisation or people responsible for it.
The app shall reference published research or documented evidence supporting the benefit it claims.
The app shall be actively maintained, and the date of its most recent update shall be visible to the user before download.
The app shall support upgrade from previous versions while maintaining data integrity.
The app shall support rollback to the previous version after an upgrade.
The app shall specify its interoperability requirements.
The app shall function as expected under its expected load on its specified software and hardware platforms.
The app shall carry a unique version identifier.
The app shall enable users to recognise whether it is appropriate for their needs.
The app shall enable specified users to learn to use its functions within a specified amount of time.
The app shall have functions and attributes that make it easy to operate and control.
The app shall prevent user operation errors.
The app shall present its functions and information in a manner that encourages continued interaction.
The app shall be usable by people of various backgrounds, including different ages, cultures, languages and education levels.
The app shall be usable by people with the widest range of capabilities, including those with disabilities affecting sight, hearing or motor function.
The app shall support accessibility features such as adjustable font size and voice navigation.
The app shall present information where needed to make its capabilities and use obvious without requiring external resources.
The app shall explain the purpose and process of its therapeutic exercises.
The app shall implement intuitive navigation patterns.
The app shall be easy to use without prior instruction.
The app shall provide interactive or multimedia content rather than text alone.
The app shall use a tone that is simple, informal and friendly.
The app shall allow the user to customise its notifications.
The app shall provide multi-language support and regional settings.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item TF33; IEC 82304-1 cl. 4.5 b)

Requirement: The app shall tailor its content to the user group it addresses.
The app shall present its information in a truthful and unbiased manner.
The app shall have documented user interface requirements.
The app shall be supplied with accompanying documents including instructions for use.
The app shall make its product identification accessible to the user during use.
The app's instructions for use shall state its intended use.
The app's instructions for use shall list its non-self-explanatory system, error and fault messages with their causes and required user actions.
The app shall provide AI transparency information in a clear and distinguishable manner no later than the first interaction.
The app's AI transparency information shall conform to applicable accessibility requirements.
The app shall ensure that user data are accessible only to those authorised to access them.
The app shall protect its data from unauthorised modification or deletion.
The app shall enable actions to be traced uniquely to the entity that performed them.
The app shall verify that the identity of a subject or resource is the one claimed.
The app shall authenticate the user before granting access to their health data.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item TF29; IEC 82304-1 cl. 4.2 d)

Requirement: The app shall sustain its operations while under attack from a malicious actor.
The app shall present a privacy policy that is clear and accessible to the user before first use.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item TF30; Rickard item 3

Requirement: The app shall encrypt sensitive user data in storage and in transmission.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item TF31; Rickard item 5

Requirement: The app shall declare where user data is stored.
The app shall protect the integrity and authenticity of stored health data.
The app shall provide protection against malicious intent.
The app shall be protected against unintended influence by other software sharing the same device resources.
The app shall support the delivery of timely security patches and updates.
The app shall be distributed through a mechanism that ensures the integrity of the installation.
The app shall support irreversible deletion of user data on decommissioning.
The app shall meet the requirements of applicable data protection regulation for protected information.
The app shall detect, log and time security compromises occurring during normal use.
The app shall protect its essential functions when its security has been compromised.
The app shall allow an authenticated privileged user to retain and recover the product configuration.
The app's instructions for use shall explain how to safely decommission the app and safeguard personal and health-related data.
The app shall document the technical security options that can be configured within it.
The app shall document its behaviour when a failure to maintain security is detected, including the impact on patient care and data.
The app shall be resilient against unauthorised third parties attempting to alter its use, outputs or performance.
The app shall include measures to prevent and detect data poisoning, model poisoning and adversarial input attacks.
The app shall constrain its operation to within safe parameters when it encounters an operational hazard.
The app shall identify courses of events or operations that can expose the user to unacceptable risk.
The app shall automatically revert to a safe operating condition in the event of a failure.
The app shall warn of unacceptable risks in sufficient time for a response that sustains safe operation.
The app shall maintain safety during and after integration with other components.
The app shall provide crisis resources reachable from within the app, including at least one hotline or emergency contact.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri item CM20; Wu Results

Requirement: The app shall allow the user to activate an emergency text or call.
The app shall allow the user to share their location during an emergency, on their own initiative and with explicit consent.
The app shall allow the user to create and store a personalised safety plan for use in a crisis.
Source (clause or item): Moumou and Idri items CM23, CM24

Requirement: The app shall provide access to crisis counsellors or mental health professionals.
Where the app assesses the user for suicidality, it shall present crisis resources together with the assessment result.
The app's instructions for use shall state known limitations and contraindications to its use.
The app shall state clearly that it is not a replacement for professional care.
The app's instructions for use shall list all safety and security warnings related to its use.
The app shall have its safety and security characteristics, identified hazards and estimated risks documented.
The app shall implement risk control measures for risks assessed as unacceptable.
The app shall implement at system level the risk control measures derived from its initial risk assessment.
The app shall state in its instructions for use the known or foreseeable circumstances of use or misuse that may lead to risks to health and safety.
The app shall provide a means to interrupt its AI system's operation and bring it to a halt in a safe state.
The app shall allow an operator to intervene in its AI system's functioning to prevent harm or hazard.
The app shall inform the user that they are interacting with an AI system.
The app shall mark synthetic audio, image, video or text output in a machine-readable format as artificially generated.
The app shall provide a chatbot for simulated therapeutic conversations.
The app shall allow the user or an authorised external agent to intervene in the functioning of its AI system in a timely manner.
The app's AI system shall maintain its level of functional correctness under varying circumstances.
The app shall communicate appropriate information about its AI system to relevant stakeholders.
The app shall automatically record events over the lifetime of its AI system.
The app's AI system shall be designed so that its operation is sufficiently transparent for its output to be interpreted and used appropriately.
The app shall declare in its instructions for use the level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity against which its AI system was tested and validated.
The app shall provide human-machine interface tools enabling effective human oversight of its AI system during use.
The app shall allow the person exercising oversight to disregard, override or reverse its AI system's output.
The app's AI system shall perform consistently in accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity throughout its lifecycle.
The app's AI system shall be resilient to errors, faults and inconsistencies arising from its interaction with users or other systems.
Where the app's AI system continues to learn after deployment, it shall mitigate the risk of biased outputs influencing future operations through feedback loops.
